name: imdb_server_role_reversal_protocol_v1
purpose: Prospectively test whether the TREC severe-routed versus severe-unfiltered accuracy reversal repeats when IMDb sentiment becomes the server target and AG News becomes off-task data.

chronology.workspace_pre_run_audit: No JSON or log under kafa_script/analysis_outputs referenced the IMDb test path or SHA-256 before this protocol.
chronology.test_bytes_touched_before_freeze: Raw bytes were hashed and line-counted for the manifest; JSON, text, and labels were not decoded by the manifest generator.
chronology.prior_task_exposure: IMDb train, its sentiment interface, and its verbalizers previously served as off-task inputs during AG/TREC development.
chronology.classification: prospective untouched-test role-reversal extension; not dataset-naive, independently preregistered, or an external replication

instrumentation_repair.failure: The generic JSONL loader did not retain the source line number required by manifest validation.
instrumentation_repair.evidence_observed: No JSON record or model evaluation metric was written; failure occurred while resolving frozen training partitions, and the required nonexistent test sentinel remained absent.
instrumentation_repair.repair: Use a canonical-deduplicating target-train loader that retains original one-indexed source lines.

data.license: IMDb license unknown in the local artifact; no redistribution claim is authorized.

development.gate: Implementation-only: all 12 records validate, the sentinel remains nonexistent, severe C/D mixtures match, and routing raises audit clean fraction above the severe 103/256 baseline. No accuracy direction is used for tuning or stopping.

official_evaluation.execution_rule: Run and retain the complete 10-by-4 matrix regardless of development direction; never add seeds based on official results.

single_primary_contrast.test: two-sided paired Student t-test over ten common seeds
single_primary_contrast.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval over paired seed differences
single_primary_contrast.sensitivity: exact two-sided paired sign-flip p-value from integer correct-count differences

analysis.confirmation_gate: Confirm the narrow cross-task routing-harm pattern only if routed audit clean fraction exceeds 103/256 and the routed-minus-severe-unfiltered accuracy interval is strictly negative with the two-sided primary p<0.05.
descriptive_only: anchor, clean-unfiltered, and severe-unfiltered arm means
selection composition, payload bytes, wall time, peak allocated GPU memory
prohibited: No additional p-values or multiplicity families
No attribution to conflict or off-task separately
No attribution to routing scores alone because the complete intervention changes set size and composition
No general robustness claim from one prospective role-reversal task

evidence_boundaries: The complete IMDb test is prospectively untouched for model assessment according to the workspace audit, but raw bytes were hashed and counted.
IMDb train and task semantics were previously used as off-task inputs; this is role reversal, not dataset-naive confirmation.
The official phase decodes and evaluates all 25,000 rows only after development completes and the protocol remains unchanged.
The audit-only clean/conflict/off-task labels do not enter routing scores; explicit off-task task membership is available through the interface.
The complete routing intervention changes both selected-set size and composition.
No privacy, security, licensing, deployment-efficiency, or population-of-tasks claim is authorized.
